# 739. Daily Temperatures

[LeetCode](https://leetcode.com/problems/daily-temperatures/) · **Medium** · Pattern: [Stack](README.md) · [All patterns](../README.md) · [Home](../../README.md)

> **Key insight:** Monotonic decreasing stack of indices; a warmer day pops and answers every colder day below it.

## Approach

1. Monotonic decreasing stack of indices; a warmer day pops and answers every colder day below it.
2. Complexity: time `O(n)`, space `O(n)`.

| | Complexity |
|---|---|
| Time | `O(n)` |
| Space | `O(n)` |

## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0739-daily-temperatures.py</code></summary>

```python
from typing import List


class Solution:
    def dailyTemperatures(self, temperatures: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        ans = [0] * len(temperatures)
        stack = []  # indices, temperatures strictly decreasing
        for i, t in enumerate(temperatures):
            while stack and temperatures[stack[-1]] < t:
                j = stack.pop()
                ans[j] = i - j
            stack.append(i)
        return ans
```

</details>
<!-- prep:solutions:end -->
